model: EWIO2 Ethernet I/O with BACnet server
applies_to: METZ CONNECT EWIO2 Ethernet I/O controllers with the BACnet server firmware (v2.1.6), both the 6-relay / 2-triac and the 4-relay / M-Bus types.
summary: The EWIO2 is an Ethernet I/O controller that runs a BACnet IP server. It exposes its relays, triacs and transistor outputs as Binary Outputs, three 0-10 V outputs as Analog Outputs, eight digital inputs (with debounce, frequency and counter objects), three universal inputs with selectable sensor types, a user-defined sensor table, an output watchdog and Modbus port settings. Extension modules, trend logs and M-Bus / Modbus data points add further objects.
notes: Names are the PICS defaults. Where the PICS spells out every channel (Analog Input E1 ... E3, Frequency DI1 ... DI8, Counter DI1 ... DI8, X 1 / Y 1 ... X 10 / Y 10, and the per-instance relay / triac / transistor list) all channels are listed. Where it prints only the first default name followed by '...' (BI 0-7 'Binary Input DI1', PIV 0-7 'Debounce Time DI1', AO 0-2 'Voltage Output O1', MSV 0-2 'Measurement Range E1', AI 10-12 'Analog Input E1 Raw'), only that first object is listed; the other channels follow on the next instances (BI 0-3 are switch inputs, BI 4-7 are 24 V optocoupler inputs; AO 0-2 are terminals O1-O3). All object names can be renamed; writing an empty name restores the default.

Binary Output layout depends on the device type: the 6-relay / 2-triac type uses BO 0-7 as K1, K2, K3, T1, T2, K4, K5, K6; the 4-relay / M-Bus type uses BO 0-3 as K1-K4. Both have transistor outputs BO 10-13.
The user-defined sensor table is headed 'Analog Value 20...39' but its own table numbers the points 1-20; it is listed here as AV 20 (X 1), AV 21 (Y 1) ... AV 39 (Y 10).
Left out: extension-module objects (instances 40-157 per module address, MV 20-25 module type), trend logs 1-400, SQLite analog values 201-600, file and structured-view objects.
Access is from the PICS: outputs are commandable; settings objects are writable and stored in the configuration file.

integration.summary: Give the EWIO2 a unique device instance (default 421000), set each universal input's range (MSV 0-2) and, if outputs must fail safe, the watchdog time (AV 9). Command the outputs through their priority arrays and read the inputs.
integration.heartbeat: AV 9 Watchdog Time (default 0 = off, up to 655.35 s). Any received BACnet APDU restarts it; on timeout all output priority arrays are cleared and outputs go to their relinquish defaults.
setup: Default device instance 421000; device name default 'EWIO2_BACnet'.
Universal input type set in MSV 0-2 (default 3 = 0-10 V).
Digital input debounce in PIV 0-7 (default 8 ms; 20-50 ms suggested for contacts).
gotchas: Hand/auto keys on the unit override outputs; the BACnet Present_Value then does not show the real output, check Feedback_Value / OVERRIDDEN.
Counter AIs carry 64-bit counts but only 24-bit precision as analog values.
